title: eDocs formats, versions and country guides
description: Find the configured eDocs family, syntax, version and profile before testing document processing.
intro: Start with the source document and the matching country guide. A country name alone does not identify a file format. A version label, XML syntax and a business profile describe different things.
evidence: The tables record a development-catalogue check on 17 October 2026 and the corresponding processing code. They describe available rules and configuration components, not a certification of every file, legal requirement or production rollout. Your organization can override the defaults.
distinctions: Family: the electronic-document format, such as XRechnung, Factur-X, KSeF or CFDI.
Syntax: the actual payload, such as UBL XML, CII XML or a PDF with embedded XML. A PDF scan, JSON export or QR image is not an equivalent XML payload.
Version: the declared publication or schema release. A generic family label does not establish support for every release.
Profile: a business or data subset, such as BASIC, EN16931, EXTENDED or self-billing. A profile is not a publication version.
Rule and components: classification, Transformation, Preview and Extraction Paths are separate. A configured profile does not necessarily have its own classification rule.
Validation and transmission: rendering or extracting a file does not by itself verify all legal rules, signatures, tax clearance or network delivery.
workflow_title: Check a format in your organization
workflow: Keep the original XML or the PDF with its embedded XML. Read the namespace, schema or customization identifier and the declared version/profile.
Open Settings → Document Types → E-Doc for the applicable business document. Search for the exact electronic-document format shown in the guide.
Check the effective Default or Custom source and its active configuration version. Inspect Transformation, Preview and Extraction Paths. Saving a draft does not activate it.
Test representative source files for each syntax, version and business document you need. Verify key fields, amounts, tax, invoice/credit-note classification and the ERP export.
Confirm validation policy and transport separately. Preserve custom mappings and check approvals and export history before restarting existing documents.
component_note: C = classification, T = Transformation, P = Preview, E = Extraction Paths. The document key is the rule/configuration lookup key; it does not guarantee the final stored invoice_type. A transformation can classify a credit note through an INVOICE mapping.
missing_note: A dash means the status check did not report a dedicated component for this exact format/document key. It does not rule out a shared or fallback mapping. Verify the effective resolver and a representative file before relying on that path.
only_note: These labels have configuration entries but no standalone classification rule in the inspected catalogue. A generic family or identity refinement may select a compatible path. Their presence alone does not prove automatic detection of that publication or profile.
no_rule: No matching classification or configuration entry was found. Current built-in support is not confirmed by this check.
screen_caption: Real development UI: the representative format and its available configuration components. Other versions are listed in the matrix.
screen_empty_caption: Real development UI: searching this country name returned no matching configuration entry in the inspected catalogue.
video_caption: Localized narration and WebVTT captions explain format selection, configuration and acceptance checks.
country_intro: Use this guide to identify the configured family and version scope before testing a source file.
acceptance: A component check confirms configuration presence. It is not an end-to-end processing test for every version. Test the exact payload and the invoice or credit-note path required by your integration.
identity_title: Factur-X / ZUGFeRD: do not invent a publication version
identity: A harmonized CII Guideline ID can identify a family and profile while sharing the same 1p0 marker across several releases. Factur-X XMP Version 1.0 is a schema marker, not a publication such as 1.08 or 1.09. ZUGFeRD XMP can declare its version. When authoritative metadata is absent, keep the generic family result and confirm the original file with the sender.
profiles: MINIMUM and BASIC WL can omit line-item information needed downstream. BASIC, EN16931/COMFORT and EXTENDED offer different data coverage. A more extensive profile can carry fields that your extraction mapping does not use. Check required fields with actual examples.
index_link: See the country guides for exact format labels, syntax, version limits and the inspected configuration state.
leaf_link: Check the country guide for version limits, effective configuration and the country explainer.
narration_workflow: Open E-Doc for the detected format. Compare Transformation, Preview and Extraction Paths. Custom rules take precedence. Saving a draft does not activate it.
narration_accept: Test an invoice and a credit note where applicable. Verify amounts, parties and the exported document type. Parsing does not prove tax clearance or network delivery.
narration_unconfirmed: No matching built-in entry was found in this catalogue. Ask support to verify the deployed mapping. Test a representative source file before rollout.
